summary: Amendment-007 preserves fail-closed behavior for root/parent/post-read replacement, production local interruption and hostile report evidence variants.
facts: Root-swap read, parent-swap write and post-read replacement attacks produce no external write or forged acceptance.
Production local interruption accepts the absent-output terminal domain only with the ordered ledger and quiescent disposal constraints.
Duplicate, conflicting-count, bad-command-hash and missing-binding report variants are rejected by task_report_verdict.
